# HEM 0.6.1b14 — Unified room and Home settings

- **Consistent room settings:** source selections and all HEM-native configuration entities use matching compact expandable sections with the same headings, icons and field counts. The old duplicate cache-only room-settings renderer was removed.
- **Complete Home Environment settings:** the Home gear now opens a grouped settings dialog with the global Home Assistant Options flow (weather and outside sources, air quality, thresholds, occupancy, sleep, notifications, language and other available controls) as well as the HEM configuration entities registered under the exact Home device.
- **Safe saving:** global source and policy changes stay as an unsaved draft until **Save**; HEM configuration entities use their individual native Home Assistant services and apply independently. Unsupported, disabled or unavailable settings cannot be changed.
- **Correct device ownership:** all HEM-native operations validate the selected integration entry, device registry and administrator access. Other rooms, devices or integrations cannot be edited accidentally. Existing Home Assistant device-page navigation remains available if the verified Home menu cannot open.
- **Stable interaction:** preserve open groups and unfinished selections during normal Home Assistant updates and avoid needless live DOM replacements. Added Chromium coverage for the real Home gear, Options drafts, exact registry controls and scope restrictions. The release validation also avoids pinning its asset checks to the previous beta version.
- Existing HEM device controls, automatic/PID behavior, safety timings, translated settings and historical release assets remain unchanged.

After updating to **v0.6.1b14**, restart Home Assistant and refresh the dashboard frontend so the updated HEM card is loaded. The native controls are fetched from the Home Assistant entity registry when the settings dialog opens.
